package.name: f1tenth_diagnostics
package.description: Calibration and diagnostic tooling for the F1TENTH stack: one-off measurement/ validation nodes (e.g. gyro bias calibration) that shouldn't live inside the production control/perception/hardware packages. Each node here is self-contained, single-purpose, and safe to run standalone -- no modifying live params, no publishing to control topics, unless a node is explicitly a diagnostic tool for that (e.g. an odom noise-floor logger).
